decision_cruda.rationale: The radio and the CMMS agree that LH-01 (N600-09) and LH-02 (N522-15) are down for a likely 4 h and 5 h, so CONFIRM-01 does not apply. Norte then has only LH-03 working, at about 35.6 t/h. Norte's 3 trucks haul about 66 t/h, and its stockpile is at 242 of 450 t, so an extra loader would not hit the cap. An LH410 at 220 m mucks about 25.4 t/h. At N600-09 (11.9 g/t, about 0.383 oz/t) that is about 9.7 oz/h. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading DS-C538-01, which costs only 0.2 oz/h. Travel to Norte is about 0.65 h, so it arrives around 10:10. That leaves about 6 loading hours before 17:00, or less if LH-01 is repaired early. The gain is roughly 60 oz before the repair, and the net is about 45 oz after allowing for LH-01 coming back earlier than the likely 4 h. I did not move LH-09, because the critical-path heading DS-E543-02 costs 4 oz/h and that nearly cancels the 8.9 oz/h it would earn at N522-15. I did not move LH-07, because it is a producing stope and its loss would offset most of the gain. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 11:00 (PM-01), so it is not available now. Reassess at 11:00 whether to send it to N522-15 (10.9 g/t, about 8.9 oz/h), keeping Norte loader production under about 95 t/h so the stockpile does not fill. No reserve is activated, because no stope has been stopped.
